titel: Keith Morrison reads Edgar Allan Poe Stories

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 2 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher; Clip-Erzeugung lieferte keinen verwendbaren Ausschnitt

einzeiler: Keith Morrison presents a new season of classic Edgar Allan Poe mystery tales.
kurzfassung: Keith Morrison introduces the fifth season of Morrison Mysteries with spooky Edgar Allan Poe stories just in time for Halloween. Listeners can expect tales of guilt, murder, and suspense brought to life by a familiar voice. The new season is available soon across major podcast platforms.
stichpunkte: Introduction to season 5 of Morrison Mysteries
Featuring classic tales of suspense and murder by Edgar Allan Poe
Includes stories about a guilty conscience and a fateful black cat
Available soon wherever podcasts are found
Followed by a promotional mention of Craig Melvin's Glass Half Full podcast
beschreibung:
Hey, Dateline fans. The trailer for season 5 of Morrison Mysteries is waiting for you…

Enter the shadowy world of Edgar Allan Poe, brought to life by the unmistakable voice of Dateline’s Keith Morrison. In Season 5 of Morrison Mysteries, experience the mystery and madness of Poe's haunting classics, The Tell-Tale Heart, The Black Cat and The Murders in the Rue Morgue.

Just search “Morrison Mysteries” to follow now or click here: swap.fm/l/mmdfd
